title: Point-to-Point Bolt-Circle Drilling Pattern
description: Four-hole mounting flange drilling sequence using APT point-to-point FROM, RAPID, and GOTO motion statements with spindle speed, coolant, and plunge feed rate control.
code:
$$ APT III Point-to-Point 4-Hole Mounting Flange Drilling Pattern
PARTNO FLANGE_DRILL_01
MACHIN / MILL, 1
UNITS / MM
INTOL / 0.01
OUTTOL / 0.01
CUTTER / 8.0
SPINDL / 2200, CLW
FEDRAT / 120.0
COOLNT / ON

$$ Clearance and hole center geometry
SETPT = POINT / 0.0, 0.0, 50.0
H1 = POINT / 25.0, 25.0, 5.0
H1D = POINT / 25.0, 25.0, -15.0
H2 = POINT / 75.0, 25.0, 5.0
H2D = POINT / 75.0, 25.0, -15.0
H3 = POINT / 75.0, 75.0, 5.0
H3D = POINT / 75.0, 75.0, -15.0
H4 = POINT / 25.0, 75.0, 5.0
H4D = POINT / 25.0, 75.0, -15.0

$$ Point-to-point drilling cycle
FROM / SETPT
RAPID
GOTO / H1
GOTO / H1D
RAPID
GOTO / H1
RAPID
GOTO / H2
GOTO / H2D
RAPID
GOTO / H2
RAPID
GOTO / H3
GOTO / H3D
RAPID
GOTO / H3
RAPID
GOTO / H4
GOTO / H4D
RAPID
GOTO / H4
RAPID
GOTO / SETPT
COOLNT / OFF
SPINDL / OFF
FINI

title: 3-Axis Rectangular Pocket Milling Path
description: Three-axis CNC rectangular pocket roughing and perimeter finishing toolpath in 6061-T6 aluminum using APT geometry definitions, plane drive surfaces, and continuous contour motion.
code:
$$ 3-Axis Rectangular Pocket Milling in 6061-T6 Aluminum
PARTNO RECT_POCKET_102
MACHIN / MILL, 2
UNITS / INCHES
INTOL / 0.001
OUTTOL / 0.001
CUTTER / 0.5
SPINDL / 3200, CLW
FEDRAT / 18.0
COOLNT / ON

$$ Pocket boundary corners and depth plane
SETPT = POINT / -1.0, -1.0, 2.0
P1 = POINT / 0.5, 0.5, -0.25
P2 = POINT / 4.5, 0.5, -0.25
P3 = POINT / 4.5, 3.0, -0.25
P4 = POINT / 0.5, 3.0, -0.25
PC1 = POINT / 1.5, 1.25, -0.25
PC2 = POINT / 3.5, 1.25, -0.25
PC3 = POINT / 3.5, 2.25, -0.25
PC4 = POINT / 1.5, 2.25, -0.25

L1 = LINE / P1, P2
L2 = LINE / P2, P3
L3 = LINE / P3, P4
L4 = LINE / P4, P1
PLB = PLANE / 0, 0, 1, -0.25

$$ Center clearing pass
FROM / SETPT
RAPID
GOTO / (POINT / 1.5, 1.25, 0.2)
GOTO / PC1
GOTO / PC2
GOTO / PC3
GOTO / PC4
GOTO / PC1

$$ Perimeter wall finish contour
GO / TO, L1, TO, PLB, TO, L4
GORGT / L1, TO, L2
GOLFT / L2, TO, L3
GOLFT / L3, TO, L4
GOLFT / L4, TO, L1
RAPID
GOTO / SETPT
COOLNT / OFF
SPINDL / OFF
FINI

title: Circular Flange Contour with Tangent Corner Arcs
description: External profiling of a pump mounting flange with tangent circular corner fillets using APT LINE, CIRCLE, PLANE, GORGT, GOFWD, and GOLFT continuous-path motion commands.
code:
$$ External Profile of Pump Mounting Flange with Tangent Corner Fillets
PARTNO PUMP_FLANGE_103
MACHIN / MILL, 1
UNITS / INCHES
INTOL / 0.0005
OUTTOL / 0.0005
CUTTER / 0.5
SPINDL / 2400, CLW
FEDRAT / 14.0
COOLNT / ON

$$ Flange corner centers and perimeter lines
SETPT = POINT / -1.5, -1.5, 1.5
P1 = POINT / 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
P2 = POINT / 6.0, 0.0, 0.0
P3 = POINT / 6.0, 4.0, 0.0
P4 = POINT / 0.0, 4.0, 0.0
C2CTR = POINT / 5.25, 0.75, 0.0
C3CTR = POINT / 5.25, 3.25, 0.0

L1 = LINE / P1, P2
L2 = LINE / P2, P3
L3 = LINE / P3, P4
L4 = LINE / P4, P1
C2 = CIRCLE / CENTER, C2CTR, RADIUS, 0.75
C3 = CIRCLE / CENTER, C3CTR, RADIUS, 0.75
PL1 = PLANE / 0, 0, 1, 0

$$ Continuous tangent contour around flange perimeter
FROM / SETPT
RAPID
GO / TO, L1, TO, PL1, TO, L4
GORGT / L1, TANTO, C2
GOFWD / C2, TANTO, L2
GOFWD / L2, TANTO, C3
GOFWD / C3, TANTO, L3
GOFWD / L3, PAST, L4
GOLFT / L4, PAST, L1
RAPID
GOTO / SETPT
COOLNT / OFF
SPINDL / OFF
FINI

title: Angled Ramp and Chamfered Boss Profile
description: Machining of an aerospace actuator housing with an angled 45-degree chamfered boss and circular bearing seat using inclined planes, multi-line intersections, and tangent circular arcs.
code:
$$ Aerospace Actuator Housing: Angled Chamfer Boss and Bearing Seat
PARTNO ACTUATOR_BOSS_104
MACHIN / MILL, 3
UNITS / MM
INTOL / 0.005
OUTTOL / 0.005
CUTTER / 12.0
SPINDL / 4500, CLW
FEDRAT / 350.0
COOLNT / ON

$$ Part geometry: chamfered pentagonal boss and circular seat
SETPT = POINT / -20.0, -20.0, 40.0
P1 = POINT / 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
P2 = POINT / 100.0, 0.0, 0.0
P3 = POINT / 120.0, 20.0, 0.0
P4 = POINT / 120.0, 80.0, 0.0
P5 = POINT / 0.0, 80.0, 0.0
BC = POINT / 60.0, 40.0, 0.0
PC1 = POINT / 0.0, 40.0, 0.0
PC2 = POINT / 120.0, 40.0, 0.0

L1 = LINE / P1, P2
LCH = LINE / P2, P3
L2 = LINE / P3, P4
L3 = LINE / P4, P5
L4 = LINE / P5, P1
LCTR = LINE / PC1, PC2
BORE = CIRCLE / CENTER, BC, RADIUS, 20.0
PLTOP = PLANE / 0, 0, 1, 0
PLZ1 = PLANE / 0, 0, 1, -5.0

$$ Rough and finish outer chamfered profile
FROM / SETPT
RAPID
GO / TO, L1, TO, PLZ1, TO, L4
GORGT / L1, TO, LCH
GOLFT / LCH, TO, L2
GOLFT / L2, TO, L3
GOLFT / L3, TO, L4
GOLFT / L4, PAST, L1

$$ Retract and interpolate central circular bearing seat
RAPID
GOTO / (POINT / 60.0, 40.0, 20.0)
FEDRAT / 180.0
GOTO / (POINT / 60.0, 40.0, -5.0)
GO / TO, BORE, TO, PLZ1
GOFWD / BORE, ON, LCTR
RAPID
GOTO / SETPT
COOLNT / OFF
SPINDL / OFF
FINI

title: Aerospace Wing Rib Pocket with Multi-Pass Depth Cuts
description: Multi-pass roughing and finishing APT program for a monolithic 7075-T6 aluminum wing rib pocket featuring tapered spar walls, corner blend fillets, and stepped Z-level planes.
code:
$$ Monolithic 7075-T6 Aerospace Wing Rib Multi-Pass Pocket Program
PARTNO WING_RIB_7075_105
MACHIN / MILL, 5
UNITS / MM
INTOL / 0.005
OUTTOL / 0.005
CUTTER / 16.0
SPINDL / 8000, CLW
FEDRAT / 900.0
COOLNT / ON

$$ Tapered wing rib pocket geometry with corner fillet circles
SETPT = POINT / -25.0, -25.0, 60.0
R1 = POINT / 15.0, 15.0, 0.0
R2 = POINT / 215.0, 25.0, 0.0
R3 = POINT / 215.0, 115.0, 0.0
R4 = POINT / 15.0, 135.0, 0.0
C2C = POINT / 199.0, 41.0, 0.0
C3C = POINT / 199.0, 99.0, 0.0

LW1 = LINE / R1, R2
LW2 = LINE / R2, R3
LW3 = LINE / R3, R4
LW4 = LINE / R4, R1
CF2 = CIRCLE / CENTER, C2C, RADIUS, 16.0
CF3 = CIRCLE / CENTER, C3C, RADIUS, 16.0

$$ Stepped Z-depth planes for roughing and finish passes
PLZ1 = PLANE / 0, 0, 1, -8.0
PLZ2 = PLANE / 0, 0, 1, -16.0
PLZ3 = PLANE / 0, 0, 1, -20.0

$$ Pass 1: Roughing depth Z = -8.0 mm
FROM / SETPT
RAPID
GOTO / (POINT / 40.0, 40.0, 10.0)
GOTO / (POINT / 40.0, 40.0, -8.0)
GO / TO, LW1, TO, PLZ1, TO, LW4
GORGT / LW1, TANTO, CF2
GOFWD / CF2, TANTO, LW2
GOFWD / LW2, TANTO, CF3
GOFWD / CF3, TANTO, LW3
GOFWD / LW3, TO, LW4
GOLFT / LW4, TO, LW1

$$ Pass 2: Roughing depth Z = -16.0 mm
GOTO / (POINT / 40.0, 40.0, -16.0)
GO / TO, LW1, TO, PLZ2, TO, LW4
GORGT / LW1, TANTO, CF2
GOFWD / CF2, TANTO, LW2
GOFWD / LW2, TANTO, CF3
GOFWD / CF3, TANTO, LW3
GOFWD / LW3, TO, LW4
GOLFT / LW4, TO, LW1

$$ Pass 3: Finish floor and walls at Z = -20.0 mm
FEDRAT / 450.0
GOTO / (POINT / 40.0, 40.0, -20.0)
GO / TO, LW1, TO, PLZ3, TO, LW4
GORGT / LW1, TANTO, CF2
GOFWD / CF2, TANTO, LW2
GOFWD / LW2, TANTO, CF3
GOFWD / CF3, TANTO, LW3
GOFWD / LW3, TO, LW4
GOLFT / LW4, TO, LW1

RAPID
GOTO / SETPT
COOLNT / OFF
SPINDL / OFF
FINI
